nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

state.prompt:
subject_definitions:
@image1 is the young scavenger woman.
@image2 and @image3 are the war walker, front and back.
@image4, @image5 and @image6 are the graveyard of giant machine wrecks, seen from three sides.
@audio1 is the voice of @image1 (S1); its words are not reused.
@audio2 is her father's voice (S2), heard only through the small radio on @image1's chest; its words are not reused.

summary:
[reference generation] @image1 wakes a buried war walker in a graveyard of giant machines while talking to her father on a radio.

detailed_description:
Gritty post-apocalyptic sci-fi feature film, photoreal, handheld 35mm, flat overcast daylight, fine ash drifting on the wind.

[Shot 1] Extreme wide shot of the graveyard, the camera Pushes forward with small amplitude at slow speed over the ash, drifting ash crossing the giant wrecks. Tiny among them, @image1 kneels beside @image2, which lies half-buried on its side in the ash, its chest and one arm exposed, its amber light dark. She lifts the radio handset from her chest strap to her mouth. @image1 (S1), breathless and quiet, says in English: "Dad. I found one. A Warden." She lowers the radio and her lips close.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut to a close-up of @image1's hands jamming a thick cable into a port on @image2's chest. The amber light behind its round speaker grille flickers, then glows steady. A man's voice (S2) crackles out of the small speaker of the radio on her chest, thin and full of static, and says in English: "Does it still work?" @image1's lips stay closed while the radio speaks.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, cut to a low angle from the ash. @image2 pushes itself up on its long arms and rises to its full height over @image1 in one slow, heavy, continuous movement, ash pouring off its shoulders in sheets. The camera Tilts up with large amplitude at slow speed to follow it. @image1 stumbles back and stares up at it. @image1 (S1), awed, says in English: "Yeah. It works." Her lips close immediately after the last word and stay closed for the rest of the video; she does not speak again. Fully risen, @image2 slowly tilts its sensor head down toward her and holds there until the end of the video. @image2 has no mouth and makes only mechanical sounds.

overall_soundscape:
Dry wind across the ash flats the whole time, with a faint metallic creak from the distant wrecks. A soft radio static hiss under the father's line. A heavy electrical thunk as the cable seats, then a rising servo whine, hydraulic groans and ash pouring off steel as the walker rises, one ground-shaking footfall, and a last slow servo whirr as its head tilts down, then wind.

non_diegetic_music:
A single low synth drone swelling slowly, a deep sub-bass pulse entering as the walker rises.
